_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: On a phone, open the sale screen at a venue whose till has page keys (Pontardawe has them down the right-hand side). The page keys should all sit together at the top, with that page's products underneath, and stay there as you move between pages.
release_notes: On a phone, the page buttons now sit together at the top, with each page's products underneath.
